summary_en: IBOKIN will acquire all remaining shares of Mitsue Co., Ltd., a construction demolition and asbestos removal company in western Harima region, through simplified share exchange at a ratio of 372.8 IBOKIN shares per Mitsue share. The transaction is scheduled to be effective on December 1, 2026. IBOKIN acquired Mitsue as a subsidiary on January 6, 2025, and aims to strengthen group demolition capabilities and expand one-stop services through full ownership.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Subsidiary Conversion of Mitsue Co., Ltd., a Consolidated Subsidiary, Through Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief:
IBOKIN resolved on November 10, 2026, to acquire all remaining shares of Mitsue Co., Ltd., its consolidated subsidiary, through a simplified share exchange. Mitsue operates demolition and asbestos removal services in the western Harima region of Hyogo Prefecture. IBOKIN originally acquired a majority stake in Mitsue on January 6, 2025, as part of its strategy to strengthen demolition capabilities and expand integrated construction services.

Under the simplified share exchange, IBOKIN will issue 14,912 treasury shares at a conversion ratio of 372.8 IBOKIN shares for each Mitsue share held by minority shareholders. IBOKIN's existing 400-share holding in Mitsue will not participate in the exchange. The share exchange ratio was validated by an independent third-party valuer, Sirius Capital Inc., using net asset value as the primary methodology. No new shares will be issued; IBOKIN will use existing treasury stock to fund the transaction.

Both companies have adopted simplified procedures under Japanese corporate law, requiring no shareholder approval unless qualifying shareholders submit objections. The transaction is scheduled to become effective on December 1, 2026. Upon completion, Mitsue will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of IBOKIN, allowing faster decision-making and more efficient allocation of group resources.
